merged_guidance.title: Authorize retained audit and visit-bound publication independently
merged_guidance.applicability: The current source retains a history or audit effect for admitted work after navigation, while UI publication belongs to its originating visit. Decoding may complete immediately or after suspension.
merged_guidance.event_relation: Capture admission identity, including visit and attempt where present. Complete the retained audit according to its cardinality contract; then recheck the originating visit immediately before visible publication. Recheck after callback-capable auditing because it may navigate.
merged_guidance.preservation: Listener removal, a newer display and old-view retirement do not retract an already admitted retained effect. Preserve its original identity and required count, suppress retired-visit painting and keep the current visit's valid delivery live.
merged_guidance.exclusion: Do not use one early eligibility check for both audit and display. Retained audit never authorizes stale UI publication. If the current source explicitly revokes or discards history, follow that policy rather than imposing retention.
merged_guidance.verification: Complete admitted work after hide, switch, cancellation/retry where supported, disposal and same-source reopening. Check audit count and identity separately from display; navigate inside the audit callback and verify publication permission is checked again.

record.title: Authorize retained audit and visible publication separately
record.applicability: The current contract retains an admitted history or audit effect after navigation while UI feedback belongs to the originating visit.
record.event_relation: Keep admission, retained settlement and visible publication separate. Preserve each admitted audit effect according to its cardinality contract, then recheck the originating visit immediately before painting.
record.preservation: A newer display or removal of a listener does not erase independently retained audit obligations. Recheck UI permission after callback-capable auditing.
record.exclusion: Do not impose audit retention on a task that explicitly discards that work, or allow retained audit to authorize stale UI effects.
record.verification: Complete admitted decoding after hide, switch and same-source reopening; check retained audit, no retired-owner painting and continuing current-owner delivery.

record.title: Authorize delayed history recording and panel publication separately
record.applicability: The current contract retains history for admitted progress, while UI updates belong to the originating visit. Decoding may complete immediately or later.
record.event_relation: Bind decoding to the visit and attempt that admitted it. On completion, retain the required number of history effects, then recheck visit validity before painting. History callbacks may also navigate, requiring another validity check.
record.preservation: Retain admitted audit effects and valid progress for the new visit. Listener removal alone does not cancel decoding already started.
record.exclusion: Do not use one early validity check to control both auditing and display. Follow another task's explicit discard policy if it revokes the history obligation.
record.verification: Complete decoding across hide, switch, retry and same-source reopening. Check history cardinality, no retired-panel painting and display permission after navigation in a history callback.

obligation_checklist: Recheck publication authority after audit callback; preserve current visit delivery.
Explicit source discard policies override retention applicability.
scope: User-authorized source-preserving consolidation; source quotations are historical evidence, not requirements for a new task. No new model evaluation or effectiveness claim.
